# 独立罢兵探针；root为报告者，actor／recipient／tca_frontier_border_war由用例准备。
# 为组件检查在同一真实战争上创建私有记录，不冒充同一场战争可反复合法问责。
tca_fw_test_record_effect = {
    scope:tca_frontier_border_war = { tca_fw_create_record_effect = yes }
    scope:tca_fw_record = { save_scope_as = tca_frontier_ceasefire_test_record }
}
tca_fw_test_refusal_effect = {
    tca_fw_test_record_effect = yes
    scope:tca_frontier_ceasefire_test_record = {
        tca_fw_order_effect = { ORDER = yes }
        tca_fw_refuse_effect = yes
    }
}

# 人物作用域；VALUE为测试期望个人Gold余额。原生add_gold不接受负参数，扣款必须走remove。
tca_fw_test_set_gold_effect = {
    if = { limit = { gold > $VALUE$ } remove_long_term_gold = { value = gold subtract = $VALUE$ } }
    else = { add_gold = { value = $VALUE$ subtract = gold } }
}
